typeDefs.name: PoolConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Configurations for managing the gRPC client connection pool.

typeDefs.name: Compression
typeDefs.description:
Represents compression options.

`AUTO`: When the service behaves as a HTTP gateway, the inbound request/response accept-encoding option is set as the
outbound request/response accept-encoding/content-encoding option
`ALWAYS`: Always set accept-encoding/content-encoding in outbound request/response
`NEVER`: Never set accept-encoding/content-encoding header in outbound request/response

typeDefs.name: Listener
typeDefs.description:
Gets called when the endpoint is being initialized during the module init time.
```ballerina
listener grpc:Listener listenerEp = new (9092);
```

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Gets called when the endpoint is being initialized during the module init time.
```ballerina
listener grpc:Listener listenerEp = new (9092);
```

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The listener port

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The server hostname

parameters.name: secureSocket
parameters.description: The SSL configurations for the server endpoint

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description:
Period of time in seconds that a connection waits for a read/write operation. Use value 0 to
disable the timeout

parameters.name: maxInboundMessageSize
parameters.description: The maximum message size to be permitted for inbound messages. Default value is 4 MB

parameters.name: maxHeaderSize
parameters.description: The maximum size of the headers to be permitted for inbound messages. Default value is 8 KB

parameters.name: reflectionEnabled
parameters.description: Support reflection

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: The listener endpoint configuration

functions.name: 'start
functions.description:
Starts the registered service.
```ballerina
error? result = listenerEp.'start();
```

functions.name: gracefulStop
functions.description:
Stops the service listener gracefully. Already-accepted requests will be served before the connection closure.
```ballerina
error? result = listenerEp.gracefulStop();
```

return.description: An `error` if an error occurred during the listener stopping process or else `()`

functions.name: immediateStop
functions.description:
Stops the registered service.
```ballerina
error? result = listenerEp.immediateStop();
```

return.description: An `error` if an error occurs while stopping the server or else `()`

functions.name: attach
functions.description:
Gets called every time a service attaches itself to this endpoint - also happens at module init time.
```ballerina
error? result = listenerEp.attach(helloService);
```

parameters.name: grpcService
parameters.description: The type of the service to be registered

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the service

return.description: An `error` if an error occurs while attaching the service or else `()`

functions.name: detach
functions.description:
Detaches an HTTP or WebSocket service from the listener. Note that detaching a WebSocket service would not affect
the functionality of the existing connections.
```ballerina
error? result = listenerEp.detach(helloService);
```

parameters.name: grpcService
parameters.description: The service to be detached

return.description: An `error` if an error occurred during the detaching of the service or else `()`

clients.name: Caller
clients.description: The base client used in the generated client code to provide remote functions for interacting with the caller.

functions.name: getId
functions.description:
Returns the unique identification of the caller.
```ballerina
int result = caller.getId();
```

return.description: caller ID

functions.name: send
functions.description:
Sends the outbound response to the caller.
```ballerina
grpc:Error? err = caller->send(message);
```

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: - The outbound response message

return.description: - A `grpc:Error` if an error occurs while sending the response or else `()`

functions.name: complete
functions.description:
Informs the caller, when the server has sent all the messages.
```ballerina
grpc:Error? result = caller->complete();
```

return.description: A `grpc:Error` if an error occurs while sending the response or else `()`

functions.name: isCancelled
functions.description:
Checks whether the connection is closed by the caller.
```ballerina
boolean result = caller.isCancelled();
```

return.description: True if the caller has already closed the connection or else false

functions.name: sendError
functions.description:
Sends a server error to the caller.
```ballerina
grpc:Error? result = caller->sendError(error grpc:AbortedError("Operation aborted"));
```

parameters.name: err
parameters.description: Error instance.

return.description: A `grpc:Error` if an error occurs while sending the response or else `()`

services.name: Service

listener.description: gRPC listener that dispatches each inbound RPC call to the matching remote method by RPC name.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The listener port

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: The listener endpoint configuration

handlerTemplates.description: Handles a simple RPC, one request message in and one response message out. The method name is the RPC name from the proto definition. Return the response directly, or take a caller and send through it, in which case the method returns error? instead.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Generated caller for this RPC, used to send the response asynchronously. Must come first when present. Declaring it changes the return type to error?.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The inbound request message. Absent when the RPC input is google.protobuf.Empty.

handlerTemplates.description: Handles a server streaming RPC, one request message in and a stream of response messages out. Return the stream directly, or take a caller and send each message through it, in which case the method returns error? instead.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Generated caller for this RPC, used to send each response message. Must come first when present. Declaring it changes the return type to error?.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The inbound request message. Absent when the RPC input is google.protobuf.Empty.

handlerTemplates.description: Handles a client streaming RPC, a stream of request messages in and one response message out. Return the response directly, or take a caller and send through it, in which case the method returns error? instead.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Generated caller for this RPC, used to send the response asynchronously. Must come first when present. Declaring it changes the return type to error?.

parameters.name: clientStream
parameters.description: The inbound request messages, consumed as a stream.

handlerTemplates.description: Handles a bidirectional streaming RPC, with request and response messages flowing independently in both directions. Taking a caller is the practical form here, since it lets responses be sent while the request stream is still being consumed.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Generated caller for this RPC, used to send response messages while the request stream is still open. Must come first when present. Declaring it changes the return type to error?.

parameters.name: clientStream
parameters.description: The inbound request messages, consumed as a stream.
